name: Delphi Turtle
description: A programming environment using turtle graphics and a version of the Pascal programming language started by Shaun Roselt.  Shaun Roselt called it 'Delphi Turtle' and Delphi is a dialect of Pascal but the code looks much simpler than complete .pas files that would be used in the Delphi IDE.  I(Josh Greig) think the Delphi Turtle code looks more like a new dialect of Pascal that implicitly supports turtle graphics and is kept very simple.
